title: ClawKeeper: Comprehensive Safety Protection for OpenClaw Agents Through Skills, Plugins, and Watchers

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-layer protection is superior to fragmented security measures

title: Terminal Agents Suffice for Enterprise Automation
task: Enterprise task automation via terminal agents
key_results: Simple terminal agents with API access match or outperform complex tool-augmented and web agent architectures on diverse real-world systems
comments: Practical finding that challenges industry assumptions about necessary complexity; validates direct programmatic interfaces over graphical abstraction layers.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Complex agentic architectures (MCP, web agents) are necessary for enterprise automation

task: Benchmarking multimodal deep research agents on process and outcome

task: Evaluating visual generative models on reasoning-centric tasks

task: Hierarchical visual website development evaluation

task: Understanding reasoning robustness under context variation

task: Evaluating agents on multimodal personal file management

hypotheses.hypothesis: Advanced MLLMs excel at cross-modal reasoning in dense personal file systems

hypotheses.hypothesis: Perception-centric long-horizon reasoning is a solved problem

hypotheses.hypothesis: Diffusion is necessary for high-quality 3D scene generation

title: Geometry driven intermediate states in artificial square ice structures
task: Investigate intermediate energy states in artificial square spin-ice plaquettes
key_results: Geometry governs energy relaxation pathways via multipolar analysis; intermediate state magnetostatic energies influence final configuration probability
comments: Systematic study of multipolar interactions reveals overlooked role of intermediate states in frustration and metastability.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Intermediate states control final metastable configurations in artificial spin ice
hypotheses.result: Confirmed through multipolar analysis and MFM experiments

title: Magnetoresistance phenomena and measurement methodologies
task: Review magnetoresistance principles, models, measurements, and applications across physical regimes
key_results: Comprehensive treatment of Drude/Boltzmann/quantum linear response theories; measurement methodologies for thin films and bulk materials; strategies to minimize artefacts (current jetting, Hall mixing, parasitic capacitance)
comments: Primer establishes magnetoresistance as versatile platform spanning classical, correlated, and topological transport; identifies intersections with nanofabrication and nonlinear physics.

title: Volumetric beam focusing: a new paradigm in extreme MIMO
task: Develop volumetric beam focusing paradigm for near-field extreme MIMO systems
key_results: Bessel and Padé–Bessel beams enable accurate 3D spatial volume focusing; distance and angular user separation demonstrated; phased array implementation techniques provided
comments: Transition from planar to spherical wave models in massive MIMO enables near-field multiple access; shifts from beamforming to beam focusing.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Specialized near-field beam profiles enable accurate volumetric focusing for 3D spatial separation

title: MYC-induced USP10 stabilizes SOX4 to promote thymocyte proliferation and leukemia onset in mice
task: Identify deubiquitinase USP10 as a MYC-SOX4 axis regulator in T-ALL
key_results: USP10 elevation in T-ALL patient blood; USP10 deficiency blocks thymocyte proliferation; USP10 stabilizes SOX4 protein; pharmacologic USP10 inhibition delays MYC-driven leukemogenesis
comments: Well-integrated molecular mechanism from screening to in vivo validation, though therapeutic window versus normal immune function needs evaluation.

title: A Labrador PeptideAtlas and DIA spectral assay library - resources for proteomics research in dogs
task: Develop mass spectrometry proteomics resources for dog genome-wide protein quantification
key_results: Labrador PeptideAtlas covering 49% of predicted UniProtKB proteome; spectral assay library identifying 11,792 proteins (56% of dog proteome); quantification of 10,140 tissue proteins and 385 plasma proteins
comments: Valuable resource creation but limited mechanistic biological insights; coverage gaps suggest incomplete proteome characterization remains.
